# es6_maps v1.0.3 - Table of Contents

## Pages

- [LICENSE](https://es6-maps.hexdocs.pm/license.md)
- [NOTICE](https://es6-maps.hexdocs.pm/notice.md)

## Modules

- [Es6Maps](https://es6-maps.hexdocs.pm/Es6Maps.md): Enables ES6-like shorthand usage of Elixir maps.
- [Es6Maps.Formatter](https://es6-maps.hexdocs.pm/Es6Maps.Formatter.md): Replaces all map keys with their shorthand form.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix compile.es6_maps](https://es6-maps.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Compile.Es6Maps.md): Injects the ES6 maps support into the Elixir compiler.
